summary: Promoted agent-message cards and folded outgoing delivery rows. Outgoing rows and the icon-only reply marker use no native title tooltips: the send time and the reply target show in the kit hover card on hover and keyboard focus, the send time is also the row trigger's accessible description, and a failed receipt is named by recipient and status with its reason as the description.

replay.detail: UI rendering changes do not alter replay or recovery triggers.

schema.detail: No database schema, tables, indexes or migrations change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or mixed-build coordination change.

compatibility.detail: New pure presentation components do not change client wire capabilities or harness admission. Applications continue to own message loading, recipient facts and receipt transport.

downtime.detail: No additional service restart or interruption is introduced.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no migration or operator action.

recovery.detail: No stored state is changed and no new rollback or roll-forward procedure is needed.
